summary: Diff adds substantial frontend admin upgrades (TREY C SECURITY section, audit log view, bulk actions bar, CSV export utility, React Query hooks) and begins backend TREY C SECURITY state/types with a rate-limit check function. However, key backend requirements (stable persistence/migration, applying protections to all mutating update calls, and clearly admin-gated observability/control endpoints + audit logging of critical actions) are not evidenced in the truncated backend diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Apply TREY C SECURITY protections to all state-mutating update calls (e.g., createOrder, updateOrderStatus, setTrackingNumber, deleteOrder, resetAllData, saveCallerUserProfile) and reject over-limit calls with a clear error mentioning TREY C SECURITY.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo shows a checkRateLimit(caller, action) helper and security state, but the diff summary does not show protected update methods calling it, nor any rejection/trap/error message containing “TREY C SECURITY”.

missing_requirements.requirement: Rate-limit state and blocklist/allowlist must persist across upgrades using stable storage (and add/adjust migration logic if needed).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary shows security-related vars (callHistory, blocklist, allowlist, securityEvents, stats) but does not show stable variables, preupgrade/postupgrade hooks, or migration logic persisting this data across upgrades.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes admin-only observability endpoints: aggregated counters, recent security events, and current configuration; non-admins denied.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend hooks call actor.getSecurityStats/getSecurityEvents/getSecurityConfig, but the backend diff excerpt does not show these methods or their admin authorization checks.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes admin-only controls to enable/disable protections, update thresholds, clear counters, and manage blocklist/allowlist; non-admins denied.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend mutations call actor.setSecurityEnabled/updateRateLimits/clearSecurityCounters/addToBlocklist/removeFromBlocklist/addToAllowlist/removeFromAllowlist, but the backend diff excerpt does not show these methods or admin gating.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin actions that change security configuration are recorded in the security event log (or dedicated admin audit log) with timestamp and admin Principal.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo defines AuditLogEntry and an auditLog list, but the diff summary does not show any code that appends audit entries for security config changes (or any admin actions).

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend records critical admin actions in an audit log that is admin-readable; admin panel can browse/filter entries.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend includes an AuditLogSection and useAuditLog hook calling actor.getAuditLog, but the backend diff excerpt does not show getAuditLog implementation, admin gating, or recording of critical actions (resets/deletes/security changes).

missing_requirements.requirement: Bulk order actions (approve/ship/delete) should exist end-to-end with confirmation prompts and per-action outcomes.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend implements bulk action UI and hooks calling actor.bulkApproveOrders/bulkShipOrders/bulkDeleteOrders, but the backend diff excerpt does not show these endpoints or their behavior/authorization.
